For instance, in perturbation experiments only a few genes change expression value, while most genes are either noisy or constant. Consequently, a genetic regulatory network is a redundant system, due to the high-dimensionality and the dependence between genes, and also a sparse system through the gene-gene interaction matrix only partially active.
